caption:
The vertex formula isn't on the SAT reference sheet.

The vertex of y = ax² + bx + c is at x = −b/(2a). Plug that x back in for the max or min.

Save this so you don't forget it.
tiktok_caption: The vertex formula isn't on the SAT reference sheet. x = −b/2a.

youtube.title: The Vertex Formula the SAT Doesn't Give You
youtube.description: The vertex formula x = −b/(2a) isn't on the SAT reference sheet. Worked example: y = 2x² − 12x + 5 has its minimum at (3, −13).
